title: Non-resident Bangladeshis
description: Buy a home in Bangladesh from abroad with Gemcon City Limited: video site visits, monthly progress photos and a clear remote buying process for NRBs.

data.headline: Buy a home in Bangladesh from wherever you live
data.subheadline: Video site visits, monthly progress reports and a legal process that works across time zones.

items.title: A dedicated NRB desk
items.text: One advisor answers your questions by phone, WhatsApp or email in your time zone.

items.title: Video site visits
items.text: An engineer walks the plot or the building with you on a live call and answers questions as you go.

items.title: Clear legal steps
items.text: Agreements are explained in plain language, and power of attorney is handled through your embassy or a local lawyer.

items.title: Monthly progress reports
items.text: Photos and engineer’s notes arrive every month, so you can follow the build from abroad.

items.title: Payments from abroad
items.text: Pay through banking channels in foreign currency, with receipts issued for every instalment.

items.title: Handover without the trip
items.text: Authorise a family member to take the keys, or let our after-sales team manage the unit until you arrive.

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.text: Share your budget, preferred area and timeline with the NRB desk.

steps.title: Take a video visit
steps.text: Join a live walk-through of the site or the show apartment, with an engineer on the call.

steps.title: Reserve your unit
steps.text: Pay the booking amount through banking channels and receive a receipt and the payment schedule.

steps.title: Sign the agreement
steps.text: Sign through a power of attorney or in person, with our legal team available to explain each clause.

steps.title: Follow the build
steps.text: Monthly progress reports and photos keep you informed until handover.

data.body:
Payments and legal notes

Rules for buying property from abroad change from time to time. Check the current position with your bank and a Bangladeshi lawyer; our team can explain the documents involved.

  • Payments are made through authorised banking channels, in foreign currency or taka as the rules allow.
  • A power of attorney signed abroad is attested by the Bangladesh embassy or consulate.
  • Your passport and a recent photograph are needed for the agreement and registration.

This page is general information, not legal advice.
